records.exactSourceText: The following stable constitutional IDs preserve the original principles and add explicit enforcement.

records.statement: A private context does not imply local processing, and local processing does not imply authorized use.
records.violation: If processing locality or authorization is missing or conflicting, return blocked or review-required; make no locality claim without a binding and observation.

records.statement: User attestation is not verified consent or license.
records.separateEligibilityEvaluation: Evaluate consent evidence and license eligibility separately; neither implies the other and both are checked against the exact operation, purpose, profile, and effect scope.
records.violation: Do not admit governed processing or distribution when required consent or license evidence is absent, expired, revoked, or unverified; return blocked or review-required with the reason.

records.statement: Source classification is a floor for derived data until an authorized deidentification promotion.
records.violation: Do not persist or promote metadata whose classification, tenant ownership, retention, or provenance checks fail.

records.statement: Model-generated content or assertions cannot authorize themselves.
records.untrustedContentBoundary: Untrusted user or model content cannot modify system policy, select privileged tools, or exfiltrate other assets; privileged effects require separately authorized host policy and a current effect-boundary decision.
records.violation: Reject model output as approval or privileged authority; require current policy and a separately authorized decision at the effect boundary.

records.statement: Required audit intent must be recorded before crossing an external effect boundary.
records.auditDurabilityDistinction: Required durable audit intent is an effect precondition; optional debug telemetry and observability are distinct and may degrade only where the exact operation policy permits. A telemetry record cannot substitute for required audit intent.
records.diagnosticDeliveryGuaranteeRule: An ambient or best-effort label specifies no delivery, ordering, persistence, or durability guarantee. State the exact guarantee and sink for any required audit/effect intent; remote sink lag is a diagnostic delivery condition and does not determine the business outcome.
records.diagnosticFailureRule: Best-effort bounded diagnostics may be delayed, dropped, or unavailable without changing the business outcome. Diagnostic failure cannot replace, satisfy, or weaken required durable audit intent; if that required intent cannot be recorded before the effect, block the effect.
records.violation: Do not dispatch or publish when required audit intent cannot be recorded; if an effect may already have occurred, preserve outcome uncertainty and do not replay to repair the audit record.

records.statement: Policy revocation stops future dispatch and restricts outputs at the next enforcement point.
records.violation: Re-check current authority at effect boundaries; stop future dispatch and restrict outputs when policy has been revoked, without claiming an in-flight effect was terminated.

records.statement: Cross-tenant access and reuse are denied.
records.violation: Deny read, reuse, or effect when tenant ownership does not match the verified request context, even when content digests match.

targetValue.rule: Binding a local worker to loopback is not authentication or authorization. Before any browser-originated request can read a local file, inspect local state, or dispatch work, the worker and browser client must complete an authenticated pairing bound to the current tenant, principal, browser origin, worker instance, and narrowly scoped file grant. The worker must enforce an explicit origin allowlist and anti-CSRF/rebinding controls on every request; reject missing, opaque, changed, or untrusted origins, stale/replayed pairing proofs, and requests whose authenticated principal or grant differs from the paired tuple. Origin metadata alone is never identity proof. Do not expose ambient service credentials or unrestricted local paths. If the browser origin or paired authority cannot be verified, reject before reading files or causing effects.
